emb:L2045356674.patient_population: Northwest European and Middle Eastern individuals aged 13-25 undergoing forensic age assessment via automated distal forearm ultrasound
emb:L2045356674.model_description: An automated ultrasound device scans the distal radius; gradient-boosting (LightGBM) models classify epiphyseal fusion stage against sex- and population-specific age thresholds, trained using reference ages from documented birthdates or Greulich-Pyle bone age. The output is a probabilistic estimate of whether an individual is below or above defined legal age thresholds, intended for radiation-free skeletal age assessment.
emb:L2045356674.headline_result: AUC approximately 0.81-1.00 near optimal age thresholds across sex-population clusters

emb:L2045450598.model_name: United Imaging Intelligence Greulich-Pyle AI software
emb:L2045450598.model_family: deep learning bone age atlas software
emb:L2045450598.clinical_problem: bone age assessment in relation to childhood obesity
emb:L2045450598.patient_population: 442 children and adolescents 6-18 years, categorized by BMI (normal weight, overweight, obese), enrolled December 2023-February 2025
emb:L2045450598.model_description: Left-hand wrist digital radiographs are input to a commercial AI system (United Imaging Intelligence Greulich-Pyle atlas software) that automatically outputs bone age; results were manually verified by two physicians. Bone age advancement (bone age minus chronological age) was then analyzed against BMI category, waist circumference, and hormonal/metabolic markers.
emb:L2045450598.release_evidence: United Imaging Intelligence Greulich-Pyle (G-P) atlas AI software
emb:L2045450598.headline_result: AI vs manual ICC = 0.992; advanced bone age (>=1 year) in 67.8% of obese vs 9.8% of normal-weight participants; obesity OR 12.63 for accelerated bone age

emb:L2045562678.model_family: cluster analysis with PCA and random forest
emb:L2045562678.patient_population: Sudanese pregnant women undergoing antenatal ultrasound
emb:L2045562678.model_description: Ultrasound-derived maternal and fetal measurements (maternal age, height, weight, gravity, parity, and ultrasound readings) are first grouped by cluster analysis, then reduced with PCA and fed into a random forest model to predict estimated fetal weight. The approach targets improved fetal weight prediction for a Sudanese population using routine antenatal ultrasound data.

emb:L2046229416.exclusion_reason: systematic review of AI tools predicting/identifying psychiatric and behavioral disorders in young people, spanning mostly non-imaging (clinical, behavioral) data with only a small MRI subset; not a radiology-focused review

emb:L2046348476.exclusion_reason: review of infrared thermography for arthropathies; non-radiologic imaging modality, not pediatric-specific

emb:L2046348889.exclusion_reason: dental imaging (panoramic radiograph third-molar detection for dental age estimation), excluded imaging domain

emb:L2046537371.model_family: various (convolutional neural networks, hybrid frameworks, 3D video-based, segmentation-driven models)
emb:L2046537371.patient_population: systematic review of 10 studies, 15,868 participants across paediatric, adult, and mixed clinical populations undergoing lung ultrasound
emb:L2046537371.model_description: Systematic review of AI-assisted lung ultrasound interpretation for pneumonia diagnosis. Included studies applied machine learning or deep learning (CNNs, hybrid frameworks, 3D video-based models, segmentation-driven systems) to lung ultrasound images to classify pneumonia versus normal lung, across paediatric and adult populations, and pooled diagnostic performance across ten eligible studies.
emb:L2046537371.headline_result: Sensitivity 88-93%, specificity 80-100%, accuracy 86-94.5% across included studies

emb:L2048716360.clinical_problem: fetal brain malformation diagnosis and biometry
emb:L2048716360.patient_population: review of fetal central nervous system ultrasound examinations
emb:L2048716360.model_description: Narrative review of deep learning applications in fetal brain ultrasound, covering standard-plane recognition, automated biometric measurements, structural identification, and malformation diagnosis. Summarizes reported clinical applications and discusses unmet clinical needs and future directions rather than presenting a single new model.

emb:L2047523844.exclusion_reason: benchmarking study of machine learning models predicting psychiatric phenotypes in youth from EEG and fMRI; neuroscience biomarker research, not a diagnostic radiology application

emb:L2046358760.exclusion_reason: review of pediatric musculoskeletal ultrasound applications generally; AI is mentioned only briefly as a future-development note, not the subject of the review

emb:L2045844181.exclusion_reason: ECG-based foundation model; not diagnostic imaging

emb:L2046276987.patient_population: 932 Gambian children under 15 years undergoing chest radiography for suspected pulmonary tuberculosis
emb:L2046276987.model_description: Digital chest radiographs from children with suspected pulmonary tuberculosis are analyzed by qXR (version 4.2.1, Qure.ai), a paediatric-optimized computer-aided detection algorithm that outputs a probability of TB-consistent abnormality. Performance was assessed against microbiological and clinical reference standards, with Bayesian latent class analysis used to account for imperfect reference standards in children.
emb:L2046276987.release_evidence: qXR-version 4.2.1 (Qure.ai), a paediatric-optimized computer-aided detection (CAD) algorithm
emb:L2046276987.headline_result: Against microbiological reference standard: AUROC 0.68, sensitivity 54%, specificity 82%; Bayesian LCA sensitivity 79-89%, specificity 82%

emb:L2038243346.model_family: compact U-Net with dual uncertainty heads (Laplacian-uncertainty framework)
emb:L2038243346.clinical_problem: fetal head biometry / segmentation for obstetric assessment
emb:L2038243346.patient_population: fetal ultrasound images from the HC18 public benchmark dataset
emb:L2038243346.model_description: A compact U-Net with two uncertainty-estimation heads segments the fetal head from 2D ultrasound images (HC18 benchmark), producing both an anatomical mask and pixel-wise confidence maps that flag anatomically ambiguous or out-of-distribution frames. The framework standardizes dataset preparation and evaluation for reproducible fetal head segmentation.
emb:L2038243346.headline_result: Mean Dice 0.9716, mean IoU 0.9454 on test set

emb:L2045669476.model_family: vision-language framework (Semantic Injection Module, Dynamic Token Selection, Collaborative Mixture of Experts)
emb:L2045669476.patient_population: pediatric chest radiographs (population not further specified)
emb:L2045669476.model_description: A vision-language deep learning framework (DSP) takes pediatric chest radiographs and generated radiology-style text captions as input. Three modules fuse image and text semantics, adaptively select informative image tokens, and route fused features through multiple experts to output a pneumonia detection prediction with interpretable, radiology-aligned reasoning.

emb:L2047521832.exclusion_reason: basic neuroscience fMRI study of visual processing of cartoons in infants; not a diagnostic radiology application

emb:L2046023579.clinical_problem: radiation dose reduction in pediatric chest CT
emb:L2046023579.patient_population: 70 children under 4 years old undergoing non-contrast chest CT for suspected pulmonary disease (plus a phantom study)
emb:L2046023579.model_description: A deep learning image reconstruction algorithm (ClearInfinity) is applied to ultra-low-dose 60 kVp chest CT scans in young children, tested at multiple reconstruction weights (40/50/60%) against a conventional 80 kVp adaptive-iterative-reconstruction protocol. Objective noise/signal-to-noise ratio and subjective image quality were compared across dose levels and reconstruction settings in both a phantom and a prospective pediatric cohort.
emb:L2046023579.release_evidence: ClearInfinity (CI), a named deep learning reconstruction product
emb:L2046023579.dataset_size: 70 children (35 conventional-dose, 35 low-dose) plus phantom study
emb:L2046023579.headline_result: Low-dose group reduced SSDE/CTDIvol/DLP by ~79-80% versus conventional dose, with comparable or better image quality at 50% CI reconstruction weight

emb:L2043794545.model_family: instance segmentation framework with structure-aware overlap metric, Laplacian regularization, and Stable Diffusion/LoRA augmentation
emb:L2043794545.patient_population: fetal brain ultrasound images across five standard planes
emb:L2043794545.model_description: A structure-aware instance segmentation framework detects and segments 25 anatomical structures across five standard fetal brain ultrasound planes. It uses a structure-aware overlap metric and improved non-maximum suppression to better detect small structures, a fine-grained segmentation head, Laplacian-based spatial regularization for boundary consistency, and a diffusion-model-based data augmentation strategy to synthesize additional training images.

emb:L2046276528.model_family: DenseNet/U-Net hybrid with feature smoothness regularization
emb:L2046276528.clinical_problem: hydrocephalus brain and CSF volume assessment
emb:L2046276528.patient_population: 167 T2-weighted MRI scans from infants with hydrocephalus
emb:L2046276528.model_description: T2-weighted MRI scans from infants with hydrocephalus are automatically segmented into CSF, brain parenchyma, and background by a DenseNet/U-Net hybrid deep learning model with feature-smoothness regularization. The model outputs volumetric measurements of brain and CSF volume for clinical monitoring of hydrocephalus, trained and evaluated on a retrospective single-center cohort split into training/validation/hold-out sets.
emb:L2046276528.headline_result: Dice 95.7% (CSF) and 96.4% (brain parenchyma) on hold-out test set, outperforming FSL FAST (85.0%, 77.9%); processing time 0.8 s/scan

emb:L2046276383.clinical_problem: screening for severe fetal growth restriction
emb:L2046276383.patient_population: 1588 annotated fetal abdominal ultrasound images from 169 term pregnancies in a low-resource setting (Uganda)
emb:L2046276383.model_description: A DenseNet-121-based deep learning model classifies 2D fetal abdominal ultrasound images by growth-restriction severity, using abdominal circumference mapped to INTERGROWTH-21st percentiles as a gestational-age-independent proxy label. It is designed as a first-line triage tool for severe fetal growth restriction in low-resource settings lacking reliable dating or Doppler access.
emb:L2046276383.release_evidence: presented as a research framework requiring prospective multi-site validation; no repository or commercial product named
emb:L2046276383.dataset_size: 1588 fetal abdominal images from 169 term pregnancies
emb:L2046276383.headline_result: 93.7% accuracy, weighted F1-score 0.76, ROC AUC >=0.98 per class on held-out data (3-fold patient-wise cross-validation)

emb:L2038203325.exclusion_reason: systematic review of deep-learning CT image reconstruction across mostly adult multi-regional CT angiography; pediatric patients mentioned only as one subgroup benefiting from dose reduction, not a pediatric-focused study

emb:L2038373305.exclusion_reason: biomechanical finite-element modeling study of ankle bone geometry from CT/MRI/AI-generated-CT in healthy ankle samples; no pediatric population specified

emb:L2038397227.model_family: logistic regression, random forest, and support vector machine on radiomics and clinical features
emb:L2038397227.clinical_problem: preoperative locoregional staging of Wilms tumor
emb:L2038397227.patient_population: 95 children with pathology-confirmed Wilms tumor (training cohort n=66, test cohort n=29)
emb:L2038397227.model_description: Preoperative portal-venous-phase abdominal CT images from children with Wilms tumor are used to extract radiomics features, combined with clinical/radiological predictors (tumor morphology). Logistic regression, random forest, and support vector machine models are trained to preoperatively classify tumors as stage I versus stage II-III to help guide surgical and treatment planning.
emb:L2038397227.headline_result: Random forest best model: test-cohort AUC 0.737, F1 score 0.615, accuracy 65.5%

emb:L2042869125.exclusion_reason: resting-state fMRI functional-connectivity study classifying age-related brain changes across the lifespan; not a pediatric-specific clinical radiology application

emb:L2043736978.exclusion_reason: resting-state fMRI-based classifier research distinguishing ASD/ADHD subtypes; exploratory neuroimaging biomarker study, not a deployed clinical radiology diagnostic application

emb:L2045437636.model_family: geometric/radiomic feature extraction with supervised machine learning classifiers
emb:L2045437636.clinical_problem: developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) detection
emb:L2045437636.patient_population: infants (mean age 4.5 +/- 0.83 months) undergoing pelvic radiography
emb:L2045437636.model_description: Pelvic radiographs of infants are segmented to isolate the hip joint articulation space, from which 99 geometric and radiomic features are extracted. Supervised machine learning classifiers use these features to distinguish normal from dysplastic hips, intended as a supplementary, more objective tool alongside traditional angular measurements for DDH screening.
emb:L2045437636.dataset_size: not stated (infant cohort, mean age 4.5 months)
emb:L2045437636.headline_result: F1-score ~80% on full dataset; 94% accuracy and 93% recall on age-matched subset

emb:L2045448801.exclusion_reason: narrative review of AI in pediatric dentistry (caries detection, orthodontic assessment); dental imaging, excluded domain

emb:L2045840487.exclusion_reason: systematic review of AI-based robotic pet therapy for patient wellbeing; not diagnostic imaging

emb:L2045665246.model_family: multimodal fusion of radiomics and deep learning (Vision Transformer, ResNet, Vision Mamba, Masked Autoencoder, Fixmatch)
emb:L2045665246.clinical_problem: prenatal diagnosis of coarctation of the aorta
emb:L2045665246.patient_population: 81 fetuses with suspected coarctation of the aorta undergoing fetal echocardiography
emb:L2045665246.model_description: Fetal echocardiography images from fetuses with suspected coarctation of the aorta are analyzed with several deep learning architectures (Vision Transformer, ResNet, Vision Mamba, Masked Autoencoder, Fixmatch) and radiomics features, then combined in a multimodal fusion model to output a diagnostic prediction for coarctation of the aorta, compared against a baseline model using standard echocardiographic features alone.
emb:L2045665246.headline_result: Multimodal fusion model AUC 0.906 vs baseline model AUC 0.707 on test set

emb:L2045170835.exclusion_reason: structural MRI study of brain volume differences in adolescent offenders for forensic/behavioral research, not a clinical radiology diagnostic application

emb:L2045129397.model_family: 3D convolutional neural network landmark regression pipeline
emb:L2045129397.patient_population: 150 3D super-resolution reconstructed fetal brain MRI volumes, gestational age 20-37 weeks, from two publicly available datasets
emb:L2045129397.model_description: A four-step deep learning pipeline takes 3D super-resolution reconstructed fetal brain MRI, uses a 3D convolutional neural network to regress anatomical landmark coordinates from brain segmentation label maps, then applies geometric optimization to refine landmarks and compute five key fetal brain biometric measurements automatically, aiming for reproducible measurement without manual tracing.
emb:L2045129397.dataset_size: 150 fetal MRI volumes from two public datasets
emb:L2045129397.headline_result: Mean absolute error below 2 mm for most measurements; mean landmark localization error below 4 mm

emb:L2045422626.model_family: graph-based deep learning (MELD Graph) and 3D nnU-Net segmentation
emb:L2045422626.clinical_problem: focal cortical dysplasia detection in pediatric epilepsy
emb:L2045422626.patient_population: 71 children evaluated for epilepsy (35 MRI-positive suspected FCD, 36 MRI-negative), single-center retrospective cohort
emb:L2045422626.model_description: 3D T1-weighted and FLAIR brain MRI from children being evaluated for epilepsy are processed by two previously developed deep-learning lesion-detection pipelines, MELD Graph and 3D-nnUNet, to flag candidate focal cortical dysplasia lesions. Detected lesions were reviewed by a pediatric neuroradiologist and scored as true or false positive/negative, externally validating both models in an independent pediatric cohort.
emb:L2045422626.headline_result: Lesion-level: MELD Graph precision 0.85/recall 0.52; 3D-nnUNet precision 0.91/recall 0.48; patient-level sensitivity 0.63 vs 0.54

emb:L2045422629.clinical_problem: fetal and neonatal brain lobar segmentation and volumetric growth assessment
emb:L2045422629.patient_population: 267 fetal and 593 neonatal MRI scans (21-44 weeks gestational/postmenstrual age), developing Human Connectome Project cohort without reported clinically significant brain anomalies
emb:L2045422629.model_description: A 3D Attention U-Net trained on a 43-label parcellation protocol automatically segments fetal and neonatal T2-weighted brain MRI into multiple lobar regions. The pipeline computes regional volumes, builds normative growth curves across 21-44 weeks gestational/postmenstrual age, and generates an automated report giving subject-specific centiles and z-scores for perinatal brain development.
emb:L2045422629.release_evidence: The full pipeline is publicly available at https://github.com/SVRTK/perinatal-brain-mri-analysis
emb:L2045422629.headline_result: Fast (<10 min/case) segmentation with high agreement to manually refined labels

emb:L2046100838.model_family: multimodal large language model (dual-stream encoding with weighted attention, fine-tuned MiniCPM-V 2.6)
emb:L2046100838.clinical_problem: thyroid ultrasound diagnostic report generation and TI-RADS classification
emb:L2046100838.patient_population: cross-sectional study across seven Chinese provinces; thyroid ultrasound performed in adults, pregnant women, and children
emb:L2046100838.model_description: A large-language-model-based framework (fine-tuned MiniCPM-V 2.6 with a dual-stream, cross-modally aligned encoder) takes thyroid ultrasound images and generates structured diagnostic reports, including standardized terminology and TI-RADS classification. Performance was measured with text-generation metrics (ROUGE-L, BLEU-4, CIDEr) and expert blind comparison against manually written reports.
emb:L2046100838.dataset_size: not stated (multi-province dataset spanning adults, pregnant women, and children)
emb:L2046100838.headline_result: TI-RADS classification accuracy 82.3%; blind-evaluation scores higher than manually written reports (9.55/9.85 vs 9.41/9.52)
emb:L2046100838.study_design: cross-sectional model development and reader evaluation

emb:L2045025011.exclusion_reason: intrapartum transperineal ultrasound study predicting maternal delivery outcome (operative vaginal delivery); the patients are women in labor, not a pediatric population

emb:L2045628810.exclusion_reason: task-based fMRI study predicting reading/literacy ability in school-aged children; basic cognitive neuroscience research, not a diagnostic radiology application

emb:L2045628495.exclusion_reason: convolutional neural network on structural MRI predicting social/environmental adolescent phenotypes; basic developmental neuroscience research, not a clinical radiology application

emb:L2042351952.model_family: GLCM texture features with LDA, SVM, and shallow neural network classifiers
emb:L2042351952.clinical_problem: fetal brain anomaly classification (arachnoid cyst, Arnold-Chiari malformation, cerebellar hypoplasia, colpocephaly)
emb:L2042351952.patient_population: fetal brain ultrasound images from an open-access dataset covering four anomaly types plus normal
emb:L2042351952.model_description: Gray-level co-occurrence matrix texture features are extracted from fetal brain ultrasound images and used to train multiclass classifiers (linear discriminant analysis, support vector machines, and shallow neural networks) to distinguish normal fetal brain from four specific anomalies: arachnoid cyst, Arnold-Chiari malformation, cerebellar hypoplasia, and colpocephaly.
emb:L2042351952.headline_result: LDA best classifier: 100% accuracy for normal, arachnoid cyst, and cerebellar hypoplasia; 89% for Arnold-Chiari malformation; 93% for colpocephaly

emb:L2044773176.model_family: light gradient boosting machine radiomics model combined with a logistic-regression clinical model
emb:L2044773176.clinical_problem: grading of neonatal acute bilirubin encephalopathy
emb:L2044773176.patient_population: 233 neonates with hyperbilirubinemia from two centers (training/internal validation n=187; external validation n=46)
emb:L2044773176.model_description: T1-weighted MRI hyperintense globus pallidus regions in neonates with hyperbilirubinemia are manually delineated for radiomics feature extraction; after feature selection, a light gradient boosting machine model is combined with a clinical logistic-regression model (birth weight, feeding method, bilirubin levels) to grade acute bilirubin encephalopathy as none, mild, or moderate-to-severe, with internal and external validation across two hospitals.
emb:L2044773176.headline_result: Combined model AUC 0.930/0.775/0.959 (internal validation) and 0.835/0.713/0.924 (external validation) for the three severity grades

emb:L2044773188.model_family: nnU-Net segmentation with NiftyMIC reconstruction and a dedicated measurement algorithm
emb:L2044773188.clinical_problem: fetal ventriculomegaly assessment (lateral ventricular width and volume)
emb:L2044773188.patient_population: 300 fetal brain MRI cases, 209 normal and 91 with isolated lateral ventricular dilation
emb:L2044773188.model_description: Fetal brain MRI slice stacks are reconstructed into high-resolution 3D images (NiftyMIC), then an nnU-Net deep-learning model automatically segments the lateral ventricles; a dedicated algorithm computes ventricular width and volume. Results were compared against manual radiologist measurements for agreement in diagnosing ventricular dilation.
emb:L2044773188.headline_result: Strong correlation with manual measurement (r=0.921 left, r=0.898 right); diagnostic accuracy 97.7% (left) and 98.7% (right) for ventricular dilation, Kappa 0.942/0.953

emb:L2045421622.model_family: multimodal large language model ensemble (MedGemma agents with soft/majority voting, GPT-OSS-20B aggregation)
emb:L2045421622.clinical_problem: pediatric pneumonia detection and severity classification
emb:L2045421622.patient_population: pediatric chest radiographs from balanced (n=900) and real-world (n=1300) datasets at a children's hospital
emb:L2045421622.model_description: Fifteen instances of a multimodal large language model (MedGemma-4B-it) each independently classify a pediatric chest X-ray into one of five pneumonia-likelihood categories, mapped to three severity classes agreed on by two radiologists. Ensemble strategies (majority voting, soft voting, and an additional LLM aggregator) combine the fifteen outputs into a single prediction, aiming for explainable, near-real-time triage support.
emb:L2045421622.release_evidence: described as a research system with potential for future integration into emergency departments; no code or product release stated
emb:L2045421622.headline_result: Soft voting OvR-AUROC 0.829 (balanced dataset) and 0.728 (real-world dataset) vs baseline 0.764 and 0.655

emb:L2044847347.exclusion_reason: functional connectivity (fMRI/MEG) research study distinguishing ADHD and ASD signatures; exploratory neuroscience biomarker research, not a clinical radiology application

emb:L2045627084.exclusion_reason: resting-state fMRI study of nonlinear brain dynamics predicting a psychological trait (transcendent thinking) in adolescents; basic neuroscience research, not diagnostic radiology

emb:L2038413066.exclusion_reason: narrative review of AI for orthodontic/dental cephalometric radiograph analysis; excluded (dental/orthodontic) imaging domain

emb:L2041856701.exclusion_reason: in vitro tissue-engineering scaffold study using synchrotron imaging and a CNN; no pediatric patient population

emb:L2041999139.model_family: YOLO-based detection with linear transformer attention (Agent Attention, SEn-CBAM, CGRFPN) and Swin Transformer classification with GRU
emb:L2041999139.clinical_problem: first-trimester fetal CNS standard plane and anatomical structure recognition for prenatal screening
emb:L2041999139.patient_population: 3425 expert-annotated first-trimester fetal CNS ultrasound images (2440 training, 612 test, 373 independent clinical validation)
emb:L2041999139.model_description: A deep-learning framework (FCNSU-NET) combines a YOLO-based object detector with attention modules to localize fetal CNS anatomical structures on first-trimester ultrasound images, then encodes detected structures and fuses them with a Swin Transformer image classifier to recognize standard imaging planes. It is intended to support earlier, more consistent detection of fetal brain abnormalities on first-trimester ultrasound.
emb:L2041999139.headline_result: mAP@0.5 95.3%, standard-plane classification accuracy 98.53%; on clinical validation set outperformed junior/intermediate physicians and matched senior experts (Kappa 0.90)
emb:L2041999139.study_design: retrospective technical development with clinical validation

emb:L2044307632.exclusion_reason: narrative review of 3D printing for airway management; AI is mentioned only briefly as a future direction, not the subject of a diagnostic imaging AI model

emb:L2044625849.exclusion_reason: diffusion MRI tractography study of white-matter geometric development and cognition in adolescents; basic developmental neuroscience research, not a clinical radiology diagnostic application

emb:L2045421693.model_family: deep learning brain-age regression models (structural MRI and segmentation-derived cortical morphology models)
emb:L2045421693.clinical_problem: neurodevelopmental delay assessment in prematurity and congenital heart disease via a brain-age biomarker
emb:L2045421693.patient_population: 1056 fetal and neonatal MRI scans (21-44 weeks) from six datasets at three centers, including preterm neonates (n=90 term-equivalent) and fetuses/neonates with congenital heart disease (n=50 fetal, n=110 postnatal)
emb:L2045421693.model_description: Structural MRI and segmentation-derived cortical-morphology deep learning models are trained on normative fetal and neonatal brain MRI (21-44 weeks) from three centers to predict a continuous 'brain age.' The difference between predicted and chronological/postmenstrual age (brain age gap) is used as a marker of neurodevelopmental delay, applied to preterm neonates and neonates with congenital heart disease before and after cardiac surgery, with saliency maps highlighting associated brain regions.
emb:L2045421693.dataset_size: 1056 scans from six datasets across three centers
emb:L2045421693.headline_result: Preterm neonates born <28 weeks: brain age gap -0.7 to -0.8 weeks at term; CHD neonates: brain age gap -1.3 to -1.8 weeks presurgery, up to -3 weeks postsurgery (p<0.05)

emb:L2045452002.exclusion_reason: review of fetal movement monitoring technologies (accelerometry, fetal ECG, maternal perception, ultrasound); not a diagnostic imaging AI review

emb:L2045554519.exclusion_reason: broad review of AI across pediatric healthcare (neonatal sepsis prediction, clinical decision support, wearables); not focused on diagnostic imaging AI

emb:L2047305494.exclusion_reason: bibliometric analysis of NIH biophotonics research funding, not an imaging AI model study

emb:L2047320210.model_family: YOLOv8 object detector with CMUNeXt encoder module, plus fusion data augmentation
emb:L2047320210.clinical_problem: detection and classification of pediatric pancreatic tumors (pancreatoblastoma vs solid pseudopapillary neoplasm)
emb:L2047320210.patient_population: 21 children with pancreatoblastoma and 70 children with solid pseudopapillary neoplasm
emb:L2047320210.model_description: Abdominal CT images from children with pancreatoblastoma or solid pseudopapillary neoplasm are manually annotated for tumor regions, then an 8-fold data-augmented training set is used to train a modified YOLOv8 object detector (with a CMUNeXt encoder module) to detect tumors and classify them into the two tumor types.
emb:L2047320210.headline_result: Best model (post-augmentation YOLOv8-CMUNeXt): precision 92.53%, recall 78.64%, mAP@0.5 86.29%, mAP0.5:0.95 68.45%, accuracy 85.71%/72.86% for the two tumor types

emb:L2044875933.exclusion_reason: task-based fMRI study of neural correlates of word-form learning in developmental language disorder; basic neuroscience research, not a diagnostic radiology application

emb:L2044875672.exclusion_reason: resting-state fMRI functional-connectivity graph-learning classifier for adolescent major depression; exploratory neuroimaging biomarker research, not a deployed diagnostic radiology application

emb:L2044686475.exclusion_reason: pharmacovigilance data-mining study of SSRI-associated birth defects using FAERS adverse-event reports; not imaging-based
